plan.notes: Source: official Xavier University Computer Science Major (BS, BA) program page, https://www.xavier.edu/computer-science/index ('Curriculum' sample course sequence with per-course credits; page last updated: September 11, 2026), hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Cross-checked against the official Xavier University Catalog 2024-2025 [ARCHIVED] (https://catalog.xavier.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=42&poid=17698&print, 'Program: Computer Science, B.S.'): 'Requirements for the Computer Science Major, BS ... Major Requirements: 42 credit hours ... TOTAL Minimum Hours Required for Degree: 120 Semester Hours'. Catalog year set to 2025-2026 (the current published catalog edition at https://catalog.xavier.edu/ as of retrieval; the program page prints no catalog year). CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the official sequence's own term credits sum to 15+15+15+15+16+16+15+12 = 119, one short of the catalog's 120-semester-hour degree minimum; total_credits is set to 119 (the sequence's own published sum) per pipeline precedent. The catalog notes electives 'may need to be a flagged course fulfilling Diversity, E/RS requirement, Oral, Quantitative, or Writing requirement'. This plan follows the B.S. track (the page's FAQ: B.S. = more in-depth computer science, mathematics and science coursework and fewer free electives; B.A. = fewer requirements, room for a second major/minor). CSCI 335/340 appears in BOTH Spring Year 3 and Spring Year 4 on the official page (identically in the archived catalog B.S. block); modeled as two separate choice slots, exactly as published. The Spring Year 4 listing on the official page reads 'Computer Science 335: Databases or CSCI 340: Networking' (typo for CSCI 335). CORE 101/102 GOA are 0-credit required courses (required_zero: true). The sample-sequence page publishes no prerequisites, so all prereq fields are empty; consult the catalog for course prerequisites. CORE 100/101/102 course codes are taken from the official catalog text. Sequence difference vs the archived 2024-2025 catalog B.S. block: the current program page places MATH 156 General Statistics (or MATH 222/256) in Fall Year 1, where the archived catalog listed CSCI 160 Mathematical Thinking for CSCI (unless ADV placement); the web page is used as the current source.
